name: Akanksha Nitture
bio:
Career Overview: Akanksha Nitture is a young Indian player beginning her professional career on the ITF circuit.

Playing Style: Known for her developing baseline game and agility, with potential to grow into an all-court player.

Career-High WTA Singles Ranking: #672 (December 23, 2024)
Career-High WTA Doubles Ranking: #1088 (December 23, 2024)

Best Grand Slam Singles Performance: Yet to compete in Grand Slam qualifying; early in her pro journey.

Notable Achievements:
  • Reached quarterfinals in $15K ITF events, showing early promise.

Other Highlights:
  • A Maharashtra native, Akanksha is building her career with consistent performances in domestic tournaments.
